I replied to Pree in their DM: on 14 October they told me their cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. I took this from the memory note I saved after that conversation.

Pree is the one who asked, in their own DM, so sharing it didn't break the privacy rule. Nothing went to anyone else. Memory also has a note on Ilse's Quarrendon cutoff, but that one is private to Ilse and I didn't use it.
